skill_name: Describe the recent rise of cryptocurrencies in the box below.
workflow: Over the past several years, cryptocurrencies have experienced a huge surge in popularity. Cryptocurrencies are digital currencies that use cryptography to secure and verify transactions. They offer an alternative to traditional forms of payment and offer more control and privacy to users. Cryptocurrencies have grown in value over the past several years and are becoming increasingly accepted by merchants and exchanges.
